name: Frontend Web Engineering
purpose: Build accessible, performant browser interfaces with semantic HTML, full keyboard operability, WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, resilient data fetching, and Lighthouse scores of 90 or above.
inputs: Wireframes or design tokens: spacing scale, color palette with contrast ratios, typography, breakpoints
API contracts for every wired endpoint: shapes, error codes, pagination cursors, rate limits
Browser and device matrix including one mid-tier Android device
Accessibility target WCAG 2.2 AA with axe-core and manual keyboard plus screen-reader passes
outputs: Accessible component or page implementation with semantic markup, keyboard support, and resilient states
Updated tests: component units, Playwright flows, axe checks wired into CI
Performance and accessibility evidence meeting the stated budgets
stop_conditions: All flows implemented with Lighthouse 90+, zero axe serious violations, and Playwright green on three engines
Design tokens or API contract missing, blocking faithful implementation
